ننتاب (form VIII)

# نُنْتَابُ (nuntābu) /nun.taː.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَابَ (intāba)
# نَنْتَابَ (nantāba) /nan.taː.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَابَ (intāba)
# نُنْتَابَ (nuntāba) /nun.taː.ba/: first-person plural non-past
